clauses.heading: Position
clauses.text: The Employee is employed as a Warehouse Shift Supervisor at the Company's Sumgayit distribution centre.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This contract is for a fixed term from 16 November 2025 to 15 November 2026.

clauses.heading: Shift pattern
clauses.text: The Employee shall work rotating shifts of eight (8) hours: the day shift from 06:00 to 14:00, the evening shift from 14:00 to 22:00 and the night shift from 22:00 to 06:00.

clauses.heading: Night shift allowance
clauses.text: The Employee shall receive an allowance of twenty percent (20%) of the hourly rate for each hour worked on the night shift.

clauses.heading: Salary
clauses.text: The Employee's gross monthly salary is AZN 1,900.

clauses.heading: Sick leave
clauses.text: The Employee is entitled to up to ten (10) days of sick leave per calendar year, paid at eighty percent (80%) of salary.

clauses.heading: Medical certificate
clauses.text: A medical certificate is required from the first day of any sickness absence.

clauses.heading: Notice
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this contract by giving fourteen (14) days' written notice.
